design.decision: Buy [A]s and become-[A] enablers ahead of everything else, and bid up on hands with several [A]s because the payout and the trick count rise together.
design.opponent: Shown after bidding; opponents void suits early so your team's [A]s get trumped and the bid is set.
design.rationale: [A] holding is the strongest-measured Ranks condition (ca-three-aces-mult +12.0), and the measured opening upgrades all target [A]s. A per-card ×mult rewards each step of the build rather than a single threshold.
design.draftText: ×1.25 contract multiplier for each [A] your team holds

critic.concerns: Same signature and amount as cut common e-hold-rank-a-xmult (a legitimate rarity move, not a pool duplicate), and differs from rc-two-hold-x only in named rank; a holdings payoff changes purchases and bids but no play.
